title: Record direct one-person Repair Crew votes under authority checks
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. Export castCrewVoteV1 for one authenticated active non-Jammed actor selecting exactly one eligible candidate in VOTE_OPEN with a current revision. Source Screen Flow locks the local vote after tap: reject a second changed vote unless an approved future contract explicitly revises that behavior. All effects are pure; service handles request idempotency and authenticated identity. Do not nominate a pair, accept boolean approval or let Shift Lead appoint Crew. Retain authoritative vote data for S2 sealed/public projection without putting private targets into generic events.
acceptance: Each eligible actor can cast one canonical candidate vote; accepted actions advance revision once without changing other votes.
Wrong phase/revision, absent or Jammed/spectator actor and ineligible target are rejected without state/RNG mutation.
The reducer emits semantic vote activity without bypassing sealed-vote privacy or creating an extra Cast/Continue gate.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
